title: The Zoho Schools Journey
description: Completed my 12th-grade education at the Government School in Aladi. Officially joined Zoho Schools on May 15, 2019. I chose the Client Web Developer track over traditional college education and completed an intensive 11-month internship, building a strong foundation in frontend technologies.

title: Remote Work & Zoho Finance
description: Transitioned to remote work during the COVID-19 pandemic. I got the incredible opportunity to join the Zoho Finance team as a Frontend Engineer, where I started working on the web application codebase for Zoho Books.

title: Return to Office & Skill Expansion
description: Transitioned back to working from the office. Deepened my expertise in modern web development, mastering tools like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

title: Building from Scratch
description: Developed the web landing page for vikkra.com, an Indian ONDC online selling platform. In the same year, I architected and built the initial website codebase for a major new Zoho Finance product: Zoho Practice

title: Taking Full Ownership
description: Currently serving as the primary frontend engineer and maintainer for the Zoho Practice website. I take full responsibility for the product's website changes, UI component development, localized page routing (like the UK edition), and Drupal CMS migrations
